The change is a new `.plan-featured .btn-primary` rule in `site/css/pages.css`, so other primary buttons are unaffected. On hover the button darkens slightly with a brightness filter, because the design tokens have no darker green.

I ran the visual tests. Only `pricing__desktop` and `pricing__phone` changed, and the report shows that one element, the Pro button, was restyled. The other 10 snapshots are unchanged. I didn't run the functional tests.

I haven't approved the new baselines, since that needs your confirmation. To approve them, tell me or run `npx testivai approve --all`. Then commit `.testivai/baselines/`.
